correctness.rationale: For each three-edge forest the incidence-vector Gram determinant is the product of component orders, giving exactly the four triple weights. Exact inclusion-exclusion gives the deletion-subgraph identity and checked A, B_adj, B_dis coefficients. The strict inequality Delta_n>2sqrt(2)(k-2) follows from an increasing two-step difference and n>=2k. Adjacent/deleted-edge-pair counting proves both extrema with all equality cases including the triangle exception at k=3. A direct finite checker verifies 2160 exhaustive deletion cases and 400 sampled larger cases; this supports but does not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: For every fixed vertex count and missing-edge budget in a natural dense range, the result globally and uniquely classifies both extremes of the third Steiner intrinsic volume, supplies a closed formula for arbitrary deletion patterns, and evaluates their sharp positive gap. This answers a substantive geometric optimization problem over all deletions rather than a single graph calculation or automatic corollary of the general wedge formula.
